# Fate UI v0.9.1-beta1

This beta adds in-process multi-window sync and a batch of conversation features: session references, direct session messages, and conversation fork deletion, plus continued work on the composer, sidebar, agent mentions, and theme service.

## Multiple synced windows

Open more than one window on the same session from **File → New Window** (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+N`). Every window shares one live Pi runtime, and runtime events already broadcast to all windows, so two views of one conversation stay in sync without a second process.

This replaces the fragile pattern of running a second Fate UI process (`fate --new-instance`) to get a second window. Two processes fighting over one session file caused stale chats and `The session change was superseded by a newer project` errors. New Window removes the file contention because there is only one session owner.

- The main process tracks every open window instead of one global window.
- Menu and shortcut commands route to the focused window.
- The shared browser host resets only when the last window closes.
- Additional windows cascade so they do not stack directly on top of the first.
- `--new-instance` stays available for isolated accounts and credentials, not for viewing the same session.

## Conversation features

- **Session references.** Attach one or more saved sessions as read-only context for the next prompt, across projects. References are deduplicated and bounded.
- **Direct session messages.** Send a message to a saved session without leaving the current view. A cold session is resumed first; `steer` injects into a running turn and `followUp` starts a new one.
- **Conversation fork deletion.** Remove an inactive conversation path from a saved session. The active branch stays intact, and the rewrite validates every JSONL entry before it touches the file.

## Orchestration and runtime

- Agent Team and subagent coordinator refinements for messaging, follow-ups, and writer ownership.
- Pi event normalization and subagent context updates to keep team activity accurate.

## Interface

- Composer, agent mentions, sidebar, and conversation-path controls received focused UX work.
- Theme service and appearance handling were cleaned up, and the packaged theme smoke now verifies Pi SDK themes load by prefix and tone instead of brittle exact names.

## Notes

- Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), and Linux x64 installers are built and smoke-tested on native runners before publish.
- Public beta installers are still unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
